_comment: Nuclear density parameters. R, a in fm; w, beta2, beta4 dimensionless. Sources: PHOBOS14 = Loizides, Nagle, Steinberg arXiv:1408.2549 (TGlauberMC); LKD18 = Loizides, Kamin, d'Enterria PRC 97 (2018) 054910 arXiv:1710.07098; Miller07 = Ann. Rev. Nucl. Part. Sci. 57 (2007) 205; STAR22 = PRC 105 (2022) 014901 arXiv:2109.00131; ALICE18Xe = PLB 790 (2019) 35 arXiv:1805.04432; LKD25 = arXiv:2507.05853. See docs/physics/01-initial-state.md.

He3.source: APPROXIMATION: Gaussian matched to the He-3 charge rms radius 1.966 fm (CODATA/Sick 2008); the published Glauber MCs use tabulated GFMC configurations (PHOBOS14) which are not shipped here. Flagged [approximate].

O16.source: 3pF, ADNDT via LKD25 Tab. 1 / PHOBOS14 Tab. I (w sign per ADNDT: -0.051)

Ne20.source: 2pF ADNDT via LKD25 Tab. 1; beta2 = 0.721 [not independently verified]; ALICE uses ab-initio bowling-pin configurations (arXiv:2509.06428)

Cu63.source: PHOBOS14 Tab. I/II; LKD18 Tab. VI/VIII

Xe129.source: ALICE18Xe; LKD18 Tab. VI/VIII (R scaled from Xe-132, beta2 interpolated)

Au197.source: PHOBOS14 Tab. II; LKD18 Tab. VI/VIII; oblate

Pb208.source: LKD18 Tab. IV (charge 2pF R=6.62 a=0.546; D2pF point-proton/neutron radii with neutron skin, PREX-II consistent)

U238.source: PHOBOS14 Tab. II (beta from Moeller et al.); prolate
